blocks.text: The exact frameworks our team uses to design, build, and ship AI automations that save clients 1,000+ hours a year.
Most teams automate the wrong thing first. They optimize a sub-step instead of replacing the workflow. The result: faster broken process.
We start by mapping the full workflow (every input, every decision, every handoff) and identify the one chokepoint where automation compounds.
Three phases, run quarterly. Each phase has a deliverable and a measurable outcome.
CleanAudit + delete. Most workflows shrink 30-40% before any automation.

How we cut a 6-step process to 2
A 15-person growth agency used 7 tools to qualify a lead. We mapped it, killed 5 tools, and replaced 4 manual handoffs with a single n8n flow + Claude agent.
Lead-to-qualified time dropped from 4 days to 11 minutes. Same team, same volume, more output. This is the same custom workflow automation process we run for every client engagement.
